terra.problem: The cookie comparison adds sneaking, which does not match the disciples openly picking and eating grain.
The rulebook line invents why the Pharisees missed the people's situation. Marking it as a guess does not permit an added reason.
Different day and same crowd claim a time and the same individuals across the two episodes that the text does not establish.
David's identity as Israel's king is a fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
David's kingship is a fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
Jesus refers to the Law; the passage does not say He hands the Pharisees a verse.
The claim that a priest from the temple would not be greater than the temple is not stated or established by the passage.
The claim about the poor being close to God's heart draws on Scripture outside the passage but has no reference.
The claim about vineyards in Jesus' teachings needs a reference. The grape joke also mentions a food that is neither in this passage nor an answer on the card.
The text gives accusation as their purpose, but does not rule out curiosity or say the question was deceptive.
Saying following was not what they had in mind adds a claim about their thoughts beyond the stated purpose of accusing Jesus.
Jesus poses a hypothetical question; the passage does not say the Pharisees have actually rescued sheep themselves.
The passage does not establish a Pharisaic rule that would make someone leave the sheep in the pit. The sheep is also part of a hypothetical question, not an actual rescue.
The explanation is generic and repeats the same point without adding insight or personality.
The reference gives the instruction to Naaman but not his identity as an army commander; that detail also needs a reference.
All in one moment adds a specific duration that the text does not give.
The explanation repeats that Jesus healed everyone several times without adding insight or personality.
The healing is stated in verse 15, not verse 16.
The trouble did not start in the synagogue: the Pharisees had already challenged Jesus about His disciples in the grainfield.
The Servant leaves them be goes beyond not breaking the reed or extinguishing the wick.
No cutting and nothing gets swapped add actions the text does not address.
The explanation quotes the verse and repeats its wording without adding insight or personality.
